partners.mechanism_chain: KIF7 (HGNC:23379) —DISRUPTS→ primary cilia assembly and function (GO:0034742); primary cilia assembly and function (GO:0034742) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal neuronal migration (HP:0002375); TUBB2B (HGNC:12495) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeleton organization (GO:0007010); cytoskeleton organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Cortical dysplasia (HP:0002069); Abnormal neuronal migration (HP:0002375) —LEADS_TO→ Cortical dysplasia (HP:0002069).
